description: Flood — Awareness — Historic — Brisbane River Floods — Jan–1974 is a dataset listed in Brisbane City Council open data portal (data.brisbane.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. This dataset, created in June 2013, represents the 1974 flood extent inside the Brisbane City Council local government area. This layer contributes to the historic Flood Awareness Map. The 1974 flood extent has been sourced from State Government. Coverage: Brisbane, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Brisbane City Council. Its tags are arcgis, environment, fam, fio, flood. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json, geojson. The portal shows 2024-09-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
